title: Xanthe and the Garden
author: Marguerite Zhou
blurb: Dominic Dravenmoor, a thief who steals memories, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
